concept.shortdesc: A concept topic provides background knowledge that supports a task or reference lookup, and contains

conbody.p:
A concept topic provides background knowledge that supports a task or reference lookup, and contains descriptive prose, definitions, diagrams, and illustrative tables. The converter classifies a section as concept when the heading carries no imperative verb and the body contains no numbered list or lookup-data table. The generated topic uses with , and all Normal paragraphs map to

elements in document order. Concept topics never contain step-by-step numbered procedures.
